name: The Venture Bros.
description: Hank and Dean Venture, with their father Doctor Venture and faithful bodyguard Brock Samson, go on wild adventures facing megalomaniacs, zombies, and suspicious ninjas, all for the glory of adventure. Or something like that.

videos.title: The Terrible Secret of Turtle Bay
videos.overview: Dr. Venture, his teen sons Hank and Dean and their bodyguard Brock head to New York City to unveil Dr Venture's new technology. They'll have to deal with mummies and crocodiles, a ninja and the Monarch who's hot on their trail.

videos.title: A Very Venture Christmas
videos.overview: Everyone on the Venture Compound prepares for Dr. Venture's Christmas Eve party.

videos.title: From the Ladle to the Grave: The Shallow Gravy Story
videos.overview: See the Venture Family as you’ve never seen them before: in a 15-minute documentary-style animated special. Follow the meteoric rise, the equally meteoric fall, and the decidedly un-meteor-like second coming of the most important band Hank Venture, Dermott Fitctel and H.E.L.P.eR. robot have ever been in: Shallow Gravy. If you’re hungry for rock, then open wide, because here comes a ladle of heavy metal fire and metaphoric meat drippings.

videos.title: A Very Venture Halloween
videos.overview: Only Team Venture knows how to put the very real, life-threatening element of danger back into Halloween.

videos.title: All This and Gargantua-2
videos.overview: Space. The final frontier, where no one can hear you scream, revenge is only served cold, and the drinks are comped in the casino. Join the Ventures–and pretty much everyone they’ve ever crossed paths with–as they rocket to the Gargantua-2 space station for an epic, hour-long adventure that will change the Ventureverse as we know it forever.

videos.title: All This and Gargantua-2 Special Epilogue
videos.overview: The Venture family and friends gather for Jonas, Jr.'s memorial service. A surprise is in store for Rusty during a reading of Jonas' will.

videos.title: Hostile Makeover Epilogue
videos.overview: The Venture family settles down for breakfast in their new home in Manhattan. Hank shows off his newest purchase.

videos.title: Season 1-4 Recap
videos.overview: Gary recaps Seasons one to four in eight minutes.

videos.title: On the Set with The Monarch
Animating Hank and Dean: Computer Magic
videos.overview: With narration by Pete White and Billy Quiz-Boy

videos.title: Larry Murphy in: Fax My Grandson - The Further Audio Adventures of Diamond Backdraft
Dia de los Dangerous!
videos.overview: When the Venture Family visits Tijuana for a lecture Dr. Venture is giving at the (community) University of Mexico, the dastardly Monarch weaves a cocoon of villainy that leaves the Venture brothers trapped in his clutches.

videos.title: Careers in Science
videos.overview: The Venture family must travel to space to repair an orbiting space station that Dr. Venture's father built in the 1970s, but a mysterious space phantom could be haunting the station!

videos.title: Home Insecurity
videos.overview: To protect the Venture compound while Brock is on his yearly mountain survival sabbatical, Dr. Venture builds a panic room and a robotic bodyguard, which are soon put to the test.

videos.title: The Incredible Mr. Brisby
videos.overview: Dr. Venture is offered a job by theme park owner and cartoon magnate Roy Brisby, who won't take no for an answer in his quest for worldwide entertainment dominance.

videos.title: Eeney, Meeney, Miney… Magic!
videos.overview: Dr. Venture's new experiment has the entire family interested--not to mention trapped inside! The Ventures' strange new neighbor, master of mysticism Dr. Orpheus, may be the only one who can help them escape.

videos.title: Ghosts of the Sargasso
videos.overview: On a scientific expedition in the Bermuda Triangle, Doc's experimental equipment awakens and possibly enrages the submerged ghost of Major Tom, a test pilot who crashed in an experimental aircraft designed by Doc's father.

videos.title: Ice Station Impossible!
videos.overview: Dr. Venture, Pete White and Master Billy Quizboy are invited to take part in a top secret government think tank run by supergenius Professor Impossible.

videos.title: Mid-Life Chrysalis
videos.overview: The Monarch sends Dr. Girlfriend undercover to seduce Dr. Venture in order to inject him with a body-altering serum.

videos.title: Are You There, God? It's Me, Dean
videos.overview: The Monarch finally has the Venture family right where he wants them hanging upside down above the Amazon river! But his victory is postponed when Dean suffers a strange but fairly common injury, acute testicular tortion.

videos.title: Tag-Sale – You're It!
videos.overview: Always short on cash, Dr. Venture decides to unload some of his father's old scientific equipment in a huge yard sale that attracts fellow scientists and super-villains alike.

videos.title: Past Tense
videos.overview: When Brock and Dr. Venture are kidnapped from the funeral of a college friend, the boys enlist the aid of the original Team Venture: a group of superscience adventurers who worked for their grandfather in the sixties.

videos.title: The Trial of the Monarch
videos.overview: The Monarch is on trial for the one crime he may not have committed, under mysterious circumstances stemming from his bitter breakup with Dr. Girlfriend.

videos.title: Return to Spider-Skull Island
videos.overview: Dr. Venture finally learns the secret of his recurring womb nightmares when a stomach tumor turns out to be something far more sinister. In a fit of jealousy over their mistaken belief their father is pregnant, the boys run away from home.

videos.title: Powerless in the Face of Death
videos.overview: Team Venture struggles to pick up the pieces of their shattered lives and move on in the wake of Hank and Dean's violent and untimely deaths.

videos.title: Hate Floats
videos.overview: Aided by Henchmen 21, 24 and new recruits, The Monarch attempts to rebuild his villainous empire and rekindle his relationship with Dr. Girlfriend.

videos.title: Assassinanny 911
videos.overview: When Brock is reactivated by O.S.I., he subcontracts his ex-girlfriend, Molotov Cocktease, to protect the Venture Compound from enemies.

videos.title: Escape to the House of Mummies Part II
videos.overview: Continuing last week's adventure, Team Venture find themselves trapped in the clutches of a bloodthirsty Egyptian cult and their time machine.

videos.title: Twenty Years to Midnight
videos.overview: Brock's discovery of a videotape from Jonas Venture Sr. sets Team Venture on a global hunt for pieces of a fantastic and potentially deadly machine.

videos.title: Victor. Echo. November.
videos.overview: Phantom Limb and Dr. Girlfriend agree to a civil double date with The Monarch to discuss his official re-entry into the Guild of Calamitous Intent.

videos.title: Love-Bheits
videos.overview: Baron Ünderbheit captures Team Venture when the X-1 crash lands in Ünderland while en route from a superscience costume party.

videos.title: Fallen Arches
videos.overview: Dr. Orpheus calls upon old friends The Alchemist and Jefferson Twilight to resurrect their former super-team, The Order of the Triad.

videos.title: Guess Who's Coming to State Dinner?
videos.overview: The ghost of Abraham Lincoln and Team Venture investigate an insidious plot to assassinate the President.

videos.title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Kills
videos.overview: The Monarch continues to rebuild his villainous empire with the aid of Dr. Henry Killinger, but Henchman 21 is suspicious of his deadly charms.

videos.title: ¡Viva los Muertos!
videos.overview: When Dr. Venture finally attains the holy grail of superscience, a gang of former teen sleuths is convinced that the Venture Compound is haunted.

videos.title: Showdown at Cremation Creek (1)
videos.overview: The stage is set for a deadly, ultimate showdown between The Monarch and Phantom Limb for the hand of Dr. Girlfriend.

videos.title: Showdown at Cremation Creek (2)
videos.overview: The fate of almost everyone in the Venture universe hangs in the balance as The Sovereign reveals his identity and stuff explode all over the place.

videos.title: Shadowman 9: In the Cradle of Destiny
videos.overview: The wait is over. The truths and half-truths about Dr. Venture's former arch nemeses, Dr. Girlfriend and The Monarch, are finally revealed (albeit obliquely) in an episode spanning twenty years.

videos.title: The Doctor Is Sin
videos.overview: Dr. Venture learns that a life with no arch enemy is not nearly so sweet when he finds himself besieged by C-list pretenders to the Monarch's throne, and his super-science business once again on the rocks.

videos.title: The Invisible Hand of Fate
videos.overview: At long last, The Venture Bros. peels away the onion-like shrouds of time for a look back into the troubled past of America's most beloved hydrocephalic former boy genius.

videos.title: Home Is Where The Hate Is
videos.overview: As The Monarch and Dr. Mrs. The Monarch settle into their new home and a new, no-more-arching-Dr.-Venture anymore life, Dr. Venture receives an unorthodox introduction to his new Guild-assigned nemesis.

videos.title: The Buddy System
videos.overview: Dr. Venture, in a bid to make some much-needed money, opens up the compound as "Rusty's Day Camp for Boy Adventurers." But while the children are kept busy with activities.

videos.title: Dr. Quymn, Medicine Woman
videos.overview: Love is in the air, kind of, when Dr. Venture encounters his childhood friend, Dr. Tara Quymn, in the Amazon Rain Forest.

videos.title: What Goes Down, Must Come Up
videos.overview: All basements are kinda spooky, but the Ventures are about to learn the hard way that beneath the foundations of the Venture Compound lie deep, dark secrets.

videos.title: Tears of a Sea Cow
videos.overview: Bored and under-whelmed with his new Guild-assigned arch-enemies, The Monarch seeks to re-spark his old hatred by secretly visiting the Venture Compound while Dr. Venture is away at the Science Now conference.

videos.title: Now Museum, Now You Don't
videos.overview: Determined to honor the father he never knew, Jonas Jr. converts Spider Skull Island into a Team Venture Museum. Unfortunately, he invited all of his father's surviving friends and enemies to the grand opening.

videos.title: The Lepidopterists
videos.overview: The Monarch launches his first attack on his new arch nemesis, the other Dr. Venture. But Jonas has the formidable defenses of Spider-Skull Island on his side, as well as his own Team Venture.

videos.title: ORB
videos.overview: A series of cryptic clues sends Team Venture out to uncover a mystery left by the late Jonas Venture, Sr. As each new solved riddle exposes one more piece of secret Venture history.

videos.title: The Family That Slays Together, Stays Together (1)
videos.overview: Brock Samson is a marked man.

videos.title: The Family That Slays Together, Stays Together (2)
videos.overview: Brock and the Venture family are on the run from the Law, the Monarch, Sgt. Hatred and the entire O.S.I.! Only bald ingenuity and an unlikely ally can possibly save their necks from the deadly noose tightening around the Venture Compound.

videos.title: Blood of the Father, Heart of Steel
videos.overview: Henchman 21 copes with life without 24. Brock and the Venture family are forced to part ways. Discover the final fate of H.E.L.P.eR. And Dean must kill Hitler.

videos.title: Handsome Ransom
videos.overview: The Monarch decides to settle for cash as the best revenge on Dr. Venture and takes Hank and Dean hostage. However, Hank is rescued by Captain Sunshine, who wants a new boy sidekick to replace his fallen comrade Wonder Boy.

videos.title: Perchance to Dean
videos.overview: Rusty begins to indoctrinate Dean into his career as a super scientist, not knowing that a deformed and believed aborted Dean clone stalks the compound. The deformed clone's attempt to kill Dean leads to a mix up with Hank thinking that he's killed his brother, while local police prepare to raid the Compound after a UPS delivery man suspects illegal activities going on.

videos.title: Return to Malice
videos.overview: Henchman 21 kidnaps the Venture brothers without The Monarch's knowledge or consent, resulting in Sgt. Hatred having to storm his former hometown of Malice to rescue his charges. We also learn of the recent activities of 21 since the death of 24.

videos.title: The Revenge Society
videos.overview: The Guild of Calamitous Intent comes under attack by an insane Phantom Limb, who now goes by the name "Revenge". Meanwhile, Hank and Sergeant Hatred must protect the compound from the Guild's agents. We also learn something very interesting about Dean's birthright.

videos.title: Self-Medication
videos.overview: While Dr. Venture goes into therapy with other boy adventurers, Sgt. Hatred takes Dean and Hank to the movies, only to have a relapse.

videos.title: The Better Man
videos.overview: After seeing the OutRider, the man who stole his wife, pass through the Second World, Dr. Orpheus is determined to do the same. Meanwhile, Hank takes Dean to the mall to teach him how to talk to girls, and Triana has a life-altering discussion with The Master.

videos.title: Pinstripes & Poltergeists
videos.overview: While the Monarch schemes to dispose of Dr. Venture once and for all, Henchman 21 seeks revenge on Brock for the death of 24.

videos.title: The Diving Bell Vs. The Butter-Glider
videos.overview: Brock, Hank, and Dean must go on a fantastic voyage into Rusty's brain to find out why he's in a coma. Meanwhile, Henchman 21 demands new henchsuits, but the Monarch is too busy obsessing with his latest purchase, a butter-glider.

videos.title: Pomp and Circuitry
videos.overview: Hank and Dean graduate from their education beds, and look into college. Hank rebels and tries to join Sphinx. Meanwhile, Phantom Limb breaks out of the Guild's dungeons and seeks revenge once more.

videos.title: Any Which Way but Zeus
videos.overview: Someone is capturing heroes and villains and taking them to a super death camp. The forces of good and evil must join forces to stop their mysterious captor.

videos.title: Everybody Comes to Hank's
videos.overview: Hank opens a detective agency and enters a dark world of sinister crime and shady women.

videos.title: Bright Lights, Dean City
videos.overview: Dean ends up interning with Professor Impossible, and discovers that his new employer is a member of the Revenge Society.

videos.title: Assisted Suicide
videos.overview: Dr. Venture is possessed by an entity that attempts to make him commit suicide, and Dr. Orpheus tries to save him.

videos.title: The Silent Partners
videos.overview: Conjectural Technologies' newfound success hits a snag when Billy is kidnapped by the same mysterious benefactors who invested in their company, and SPHINX launches an investigation aimed at determining who is behind these dubious financiers.

videos.title: Operation: P.R.O.M.
videos.overview: Team Venture, Conjectural Technologies and the Order of the Triad come together as Dean and Hank prepare to face an obstacle that is more intimidating then anything they have confronted before: a prom to celebrate their "graduating" high school, while Dr. Venture throws out all the stops to bring the twins the best dance $500 can buy. But when things go awry, the greatest battle in Venture history looms as two old enemies - the OSI and SPHINX - clash once again.

videos.title: What Color Is Your Cleansuit?
videos.overview: A three-month period in the lives of our heroes and villains is chronicled. Dr. Venture recruits college interns to help him complete a project for J.J. in time, but things go awry. Dean makes a life-changing decision after Triana rejects him, and Billy Quizboy acquires a new archenemy.

videos.title: Venture Libre
videos.overview: The Ventures travel into the jungles of Central America to find an invention that has developed a mind of its own.

videos.title: SPHINX Rising
videos.overview: While the Monarch and his wife attempt to destroy the Venture compound once and for all, the Monarch learns a startling secret about his past. Meanwhile, Twenty-One tries to create a new SPHINX... and inadvertently recruits the members of the old SPHINX.

videos.title: Spanakopita!
videos.overview: A figure from Dr. Venture's past haunts him during his annual vacation to Spanikos.

videos.title: O.S.I. Love You
videos.overview: OSI has a riot on their hands when the super-villains in their custody make a desperate bid to escape.

videos.title: Momma's Boys
videos.overview: Dean pays a visit to the mystery woman in his life, while Hank and Dermott play a prank on Dr. Venture which leads him on a quest to find his mystery friend and rescue him.

videos.title: Bot Seeks Bot
videos.overview: Brock goes undercover to rescue a volunteer undercover operative helping the OSI track down the Council of 13, and ends up in a night club...

videos.title: The Devil's Grip
videos.overview: When Rusty is apparently killed by the Monarch, Hatred sends the boys off to live with their godparents, and then turns to Twenty-One for help to infiltrate the Flying Cocoon and recover Rusty's body.

videos.title: Hostile Makeover
videos.overview: The Ventures are back! And they’re movin’ on up to a deluxe apartment in the sky. But will mo’ money bring mo’ problems? And can The Monarch handle the commute?

videos.title: Maybe No Go
videos.overview: White and Billy grapple with their archenemy in their old neighborhood; Doc realizes he cannot face his responsibilities alone.

videos.title: Faking Miracles
videos.overview: Doc uncovers a mysterious invention that could make or break Dean's college aspirations and The Monarch makes a bad first impression on Dr. Mrs. The Monarch's co-workers.

videos.title: Rapacity In Blue
videos.overview: A super villain launches an assault on the Ventures and Doc's latest invention or a blue vigilante may save the day.

videos.title: Tanks for Nuthin'
videos.overview: A super-widow surfaces and makes Dr. Mrs. The Monarch's job difficult while a criminal genius tries to arch Dr. Venture.

videos.title: It Happening One Night
videos.overview: Avant-garde supervillains try to arch Dr. Venture while Hank searches for love in a den of ninjas.

videos.title: A Party for Tarzan
videos.overview: In a case of mistaken identity, the Guild targets Dr. Venture for assassination, pooping his party for a fancy new friend.

videos.title: Red Means Stop
videos.overview: The Guild of Calamitous Intent sets a trap for Blue Morpho with a notorious villain as the bait. Meanwhile, two battered men struggle to escape from their mysterious imprisonment.

videos.title: The Venture Bros. and the Curse of the Haunted Problem
videos.overview: The Venture headquarters is either possessed, just regular haunted, or suffering from a computer glitch; Dr. Orpheus and the Order of the Triad are called upon to unlock the mystery.

videos.title: The Rorqual Affair
videos.overview: Deadly waters surround the Monarch when he becomes Wide Wale’s prisoner

videos.title: Arrears in Science
videos.overview: The Morphic Trilogy reaches its conclusion in a decades-spanning tale of friendship, betrayal and mass murder that overwrites Venture history.

videos.title: The High Cost of Loathing
videos.overview: The Monarch faces financial challenges as he attempts to rebuild his fiendish organization; Dean tries to establish a normal life outside of his father's shadow at sleep-away college.

videos.title: The Inamorata Consequence
videos.overview: The Venture family returns to their old compound where intrigue, danger, jackets, and diplomacy await.

videos.title: The Bellicose Proxy
videos.overview: The Monarch and 21 play a deadly game of tutoring an inexperienced villain; a hot plate of danger is served up with a side of hilarity.

videos.title: The Unicorn in Captivity
videos.overview: Dr. Venture's latest invention is a real game-changer, and the new game is deadly.

videos.title: The Terminus Mandate
videos.overview: The members of Guild Council must face their archrivals for one last time, while Doc happily falls into a black widow's deadly web.

videos.title: The Forecast Manufacturer
videos.overview: The city is hit with a mysterious blizzard that launches Team Venture into action; the Monarch and 21 are sent on a deadly mission to a secret island fortress.

videos.title: The Saphrax Protocol
videos.overview: Deep inside Guild Headquarters, the Monarch and 21 face their ultimate ordeal; the Venture brothers confront one of their own.
